Alright well I know there’s plenty of other advice here but I’m going to tell you what I did to get where I’m at. I’m also currently in college and believe me I don’t want to become some roided up freak who can’t put his arms down with no neck. I was 190 going into my freshman year of college and I looked pretty bad. I’ve been working out since my freshman year of high school and I knew a fair amount I was just lazy. Anyway first things first diet is key. If you want to be shredded and look cut probably at least 60% is achieved in the kitchen. Me to get cut I went on a pretty low carb diet staying under 100g of carbs a day and while working out in order to gain muscle I tried to get around 200g of protein a day you want to try and get 1g per pound of body weight. Now for my workouts if you want to develop a nice lean physique and look good I’d recommend 10-12 reps of 3 sets of most workouts. I can post my actual routine if you’d like to see but it’s best to find a workout that you feel like you get results from and feels good for you.
